Elements.Name: Enabled
Description: Show the SONIC MANIA button in the main menu (the Museum / My Data / Options island).
It only appears when the Sonic Mania decompilation is found.

Elements.Name: Path
Description: The folder of your Windows build of the Sonic Mania decompilation: the one with RSDKv5U.exe,
Game.dll and Data.rsdk (or the full path of RSDKv5U.exe). Examples: C:\Games\ManiaDecomp,
Leave it empty to look in Steam's Sonic Mania folder (where most people put the decompilation).
If the button doesn't show, ManiaLockOn.log in this mod's folder says where it looked.
